articles.title: Google makes Wear OS Clock app Pixel Watch exclusive as non Pixel users lose Play Store updates
articles.description: Google is making the Wear OS Clock app exclusive to the Pixel Watch. Non Pixel watches lose Play Store access and updates, though installs still work on those devices. Brands Samsung and OnePlus will use maker clock apps for alarms, timers and watch face shortcuts.

articles.title: Xiaomi launches new upgraded smart lock with dual cameras
articles.description: Xiaomi has revealed the Smart Door Lock 4 Pro Dual Camera Edition in China. It offers several upgrades compared to the original model, released earlier this year. These include a second camera and a larger battery, with the same twelve unlocking methods, including facial recognition and a fingerprint scanner.
